witness.explanation: Projection can kill directions; independence before projection does not imply independence afterward.
witness.evidence: Of the28 old directions,16 degree-3/4 Walsh directions are individually zero on all retained coordinates. The surviving image has rank12: a retained12-by-12 minor has determinant -120231596497305600, and the16 zero directions give the matching upper bound. Therefore the supported kernel bound is at least12, giving rank<=746825-12=746813; the claimed746825-28=746797 does not follow.
